# Cincy Crashe

```{r}

crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day

crashes_by_day = c(2020, 2241, 2327, 2285,
                   2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day
crashes_by_day > 2000
```

# Type

```{r}
typeof(crashes_per_day_int)

crashes_by_day_int = c(2020L, 2241L, 2327L, 2285L,
                   2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
typeof(crashes_by_day_int)

```
